title: mirabilis laevis var. retrorsa
intro: Mirabilis laevis var. retrorsa, commonly known as the California salsify or western salsify, is a plant species that belongs to the Four O'Clock family (Nyctaginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis laevis var. retrorsa include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a promising remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
